ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
አዛርያስ: አዛርያስ — Azariah (proper name; here son of Zadok, high priest)
ለንግሥት: ንግሥት — to the queen (ለ- + noun, fem.)
ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her') · masculine form where a woman speaks to her sister and ትቤላ is expected (ወይቤላ ዝንቱ ንዋየ አቡነ 'and she said to her: this property of our father') (?)
በአማን: አማን — truth; በአማን 'in truth, truly' (በ- + noun)
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)

እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')

እግዚእየ: እግዚእ — my lord (noun + -የ '1cs my') · vocative 'my lord' (ብቊዐኒ እግዚእየ) · in apposition, 'David, my lord' (አቡየ ዳዊት እግዚእየ)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will')
ንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — as for us (1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ቀደምት: ቀዳማይ — former, ancient, first (adjective, plural ቀደምት, agreeing with አበዊነ 'our fathers') (?)
ንቤ: ብህለ — we said (1cp perfect ንቤ of the defective ይቤ, ትቤ, ንቤ; b-h-l)
ቤተ: ቤት — house (noun, construct state 'house-of') · accusative 'the house' as object of a verb (የኀድጋ ቤተ 'they leave the house')
አብዝኀ: አብዝኀ — he multiplied, made many (3ms perfect, causative of በዝኀ)
ሠምረ: ሠምረ — he willed, was pleased (3ms perfect, G, ś-m-r)
ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
ወይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — and now, as for (ወ- 'and' + adverb 'now' + contrastive enclitic -ሰ 'as for, but')
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?)
ትኄይስ: ኀየሰ — she is better (3fs imperfect, G)
ሀገረ: ሀገር — city, country (noun; construct 'city of') · accusative 'the city' as object of አዖድዎ ('they led him around the city') · accusative of place 'in the city' (ይነብር ሀገረ 'he would stay in the city')
እምብሔረ: ብሔር — from the land of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
በጻሕነ: በጽሐ — we have arrived (1cp perfect, b-ṣ-ḥ)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
ዘርኢነ: ርእየ — what we saw, that which we saw (ዘ- + 1cp perfect, r-ʾ-y)
ሠናይ: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adj.) · 'good' as a substantive (ዘይረክበከ ሠናይ 'what good will find you')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ወእንስሳ: እንስሳ — and livestock, animals (ወ- + collective noun, accusative)
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ፀዋገ: ፀዋግ — captor, one who takes captive (noun; accusative; lexical call from context) (?) · 'grim (?)' here, predicate of ኮነ before ከመ ድብ 'like a bear' (ወውእቱሰ ኮነ ፀዋገ 'and he became grim (?)'; one more guess) (?)
እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected') · 'from what' (እምዘ ንኤዝዘከ 'from what we command you') · 'since' of time (እምዘ ኀለፉ 'since they passed')
ንሰምዕ: ሰምዐ — we hear (1cp imperfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
ን: እብን — -ን, second half of በአእባን 'with stones', split off by a stray wordspace
ሀለወት: ሀለወ — she was, she was present (3fs perfect, h-l-w)
ኮንክሙ: ኮነ — you became (2mp perfect, G, k-w-n, ending -ክሙ)
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ዘእቤ: ብህለ — which I speak of, say (ዘ- relative + 1s imperfect እቤ, b-h-l)
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
ወብትክ: ብትክ — ? (?) unknown (ወ- + noun), perhaps 'cutting off' (cf. በተከ)
ብክሙ: በ — with you, you have (preposition በ + -ክሙ '2mp'; ብክሙ 'there is with you')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
እምቃሉ: ቃል — from his word (እም- 'from' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
አዘዞሙ: አዘዘ — he commanded them (3ms perfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them')
ለአበዊነ: አብ — to our fathers (ለ- + plural አበው, አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ይዕቀቡ: ዐቀበ — that they keep (3mp jussive, ʿ-q-b)
ኢለየማን: የማን — not to the right (ኢ- + ለ- + noun 'right hand, right')

እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
ሥምረቶ: ሥምረት — his good pleasure (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር)
አኮኑ: አኮ — is it not so? are we not? (negative አኮ + interrogative -ኑ)
ለኵልክሙ: ኵሉ — to all of you, for all of you (ለ- + ኵል- + -ክሙ '2mp you')
ምንተ: ምንት — what? (interrogative pronoun, accusative) · exclamatory 'how' (ምንተ ሠነየኒ ቃልከ 'how pleasing to me is your word')
ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
ወስምዑ: ሰምዐ — hear, listen (2mp imperative, G stem; ወ- 'and')
ትእዛዞ: ትእዛዝ — his command (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the command of God') · his commandment, as a plain object with no owner named after it (ዐቀብከ ትእዛዞ 'you have kept his commandment')

ኢይትኀየል: ተኀየለ — that he/I not take by force (neg. ኢ- + jussive, tä-stem, 'be overpowered, take by force'); form 3ms though the sense is the speaker's
ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
ወኢትትዓመፁ: ተዓመፀ — and do not wrong one another (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp jussive, reciprocal tä-stem of ዐመፀ)
ወለእመቦ: እመ — and if there is (ወ- + ለእመ conditional + ቦ 'there is')
አግብኡ: አግብአ — they brought in, brought to (3m pl perfect, causative of ገብአ 'enter, return')
ወለእመሰ: እመ — and if indeed, but if (ወ- + ለእመ + enclitic -ሰ contrastive)
ባዕለ: ባዕል — owner, lord (noun; construct 'owner of') · accusative predicate 'rich' (ወኮነ ባዕለ ጥቀ 'he became exceedingly rich'; 'powerful' is also possible (?))
ንዋዮ: ንዋይ — his goods, property (noun, accusative + -ሁ '3ms his', ንዋዮ)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
ማኅፈደ: ማኅፈድ — tower (?) of (noun, construct) (?) · in ch. 36 ማኅፈደ ዳዊት ('figure, likeness (?) of David'); 'tower' fits poorly unless figurative for stature; sense from context (?) · in ማኅፈደ ነዋኃት (ch. 55) 'tall towers (?)', again uncertain (?)
ዘጾረ: ጾረ — one who bore, carried (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, ṣ-w-r)
ለእመኒ: እመ — even if, even though (ለእመ + emphatic -ኒ)
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ) · 'its mother' of an animal (ጽጉበ ሐሊበ እሙ 'sated with its mother's milk'; ch. 53)
ፍትሐ: ፍትሕ — judgment, justice (noun, accusative) · construct 'judgment of' (ፍትሐ ሕዝበ አምላከ እስራኤል 'judgment of the people of the God of Israel')
ማውታ: ሙት — the dead; carrion (plural ማውታ, cf. ዕጓለ ማውታ 'orphan', lit. 'child of the dead'; sense here uncertain)
ለገጽ: ገጽ — to the face, to appearance (ለ- + noun; ኢያደሉ ለገጽ 'show no partiality')
ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)

ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
ዘአዘዘ: አዘዘ — which he commanded (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
እኪት: እኩይ — evil, wicked (adjective, fem. እኪት; masc. እኩይ)
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
ዘይገብር: ገብረ — who does, who works (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
ሰብእ: ሰብእ — man, human being, people (noun) · 'humankind' (መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of humankind')
አምላክ: አምላክ — God, god (noun, singular; here 'a God') · 'god' in ዘእምአምላክ 'that is from god' (no article)

ለአዳም: አዳም — of/for Adam · Adam as object, marked with ለ- (ሤሞ ለአዳም 'he appointed Adam')

ወኵልነ: ኵሉ — and all of us (ወ- + ኵሉ + -ነ '1cp us')
ርጉመ: ርጉም — cursed (passive participle of ረገመ; accusative predicate)
ለይኩን: ኮነ — let it be (ለ- jussive particle + 3ms jussive ይኩን, k-w-n)
ነፍሰ: ነፍስ — soul, life, person (noun, accusative) · construct 'soul of' (ነፍሰ ዳዊት 'the soul of David')
ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
ባዕደ: ባዕድ — other, foreign (adjective, accusative masc. sg., agreeing with አማልክተ)
ቀናኢ: ቀናኢ — jealous, zealous (adjective, participial, from ቀነአ; masc. sg.)
ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for')
ወይገብሩ: ገብረ — and they make (ወ- 'and' + 3mp imperfect, G, g-b-r)
ላዕሌሆሙ: ላዕለ — upon them, over them (preposition + 3mp suffix)
ይሤርዎሙ: ሠረወ — he will uproot them (3ms imperfect ይሤርው, G, + -ሙ '3mp them')
እምድር: ምድር — from the earth (እም- + ምድር, the doubled ም written once; the Hebrew of 1 Samuel 2:8 has 'dust', this text does not)
ወያጠፍእ: አጠፍአ — and he destroys (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative አ- stem, ṭ-f-ʾ)
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity') · 'of the world', the owner after an anticipating suffix (ብርሃኖ ለዓለም 'the light of the world') · 'for ever' also after ካህኑ: 'his priest for ever', or 'priest of the world' (?)
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
ይትገሐሡ: ተገሐሠ — they hasten, move about (?) (3mp subjunctive, tä-stem); root and sense uncertain, perhaps related to ገሠሠ 'go about' (?)
እምእለ: እለ — more than those who (እም- comparative + relative pronoun) · from among those who, of those who (እም- partitive; ፩ እምእለ ይቴሐቱ 'one of those who are humbled')
ትመጽእ: መጽአ — she came (3fs imperfect, used for a past event after ሶበ 'when', m-ṣ-ʾ)
ለኃጥኣን: ኃጥእ — the sinners (ለ- marking the object + plural ኃጥኣን)
እምፍኖተ: ፍኖት — from the way of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct state)
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ለእግዚእነ: እግዚእ — to our Lord (ለ- + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
ኢየኀድግ: ኀደገ — he does not leave (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, G, ḫ-d-g); with the speaker's own 'I' as sense, 'I will not leave' (?)
በትረ: በትር — rod, staff (construct 'rod of') · also accusative 'rod(s)' after a number (ሠለስተ በትረ 'three rods')
ለብእሲ: ብእሲ — to/of a man, someone (ለ- + noun)
ሠናየ: ሠናይ — good (accusative, adj. as noun) · adjective 'good, fine' agreeing with a noun (ልብሰ ሠናየ 'a fine garment')
ይዕቀብ: ዐቀበ — that he keep (G 3ms subjunctive, ʿ-q-b)
ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n) · let it be (3ms jussive, here after ዘእንበለ 'except': ዘእንበለ ይኩን ቆዐ ሠርጸ ጽጌ 'except it be that the tendril put forth blossom') (?)
ክልኤ: ክልኤቱ — two (numeral; the short form ክልኤ before a noun)
ወይከውን: ኮነ — and it will be (ወ- + 3ms imperf., k-w-n)
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am')
ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
ለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — he himself, his very self
ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
ትከውኑ: ኮነ — you (mp) are, will be (2mp imperfect, k-w-n)
